examples.vi: Vèo một cái! Chiếc xe lao vun vút xuống phố rồi biến mất.

wiktionary.gloss: Imitative of high-pitched sound of a small object moving rapidly through air.

senses.definition: to fasten or close clothes, bags, or other items with a zip

examples.en: He zipped his coat before going out into the rain.
examples.vi: Anh ấy kéo khóa áo khoác trước khi đi ra ngoài trời mưa.

examples.en: Just zip your lip and listen carefully.
examples.vi: Hãy ngậm miệng lại và chăm chú lắng nghe.

senses.definition: to move somewhere very quickly

examples.en: Motorbikes zipped through the busy city traffic.
examples.vi: Những chiếc xe máy phóng vèo qua dòng xe cộ đông đúc của thành phố.

examples.en: I need to zip home to grab my keys.
examples.vi: Tôi cần chạy vội về nhà để lấy chìa khóa.

senses.vi: phóng nhanh; lao vèo; chạy vụt

senses.definition: to compress one or more computer files so they take up less space

examples.en: You should zip the photos before attaching them to the email.
examples.vi: Bạn nên nén các bức ảnh lại trước khi đính kèm vào email.

thesaurus.definition: close with a zipper
move very fast

wiktionary.gloss: To close with a zip fastener.

examples: Zip your lip!
wiktionary.gloss: To close as if with a zip fastener.
To compress (one or more computer files) into a single and often smaller file, especially one in the ZIP format.
To subject to the convolution mapping function.

examples: The bullet zipped through the air.
wiktionary.gloss: To move rapidly (in a specified direction or to a specified place) with a high-pitched sound.

examples: Zip down to the shops for some milk.
wiktionary.gloss: To move in haste (in a specified direction or to a specified place).
To make (something) move quickly
To travel on a zipline.
To offer a list of alternately male and female candidates in an attempt to address the shortage of women.

idioms.gloss: To refrain from or to stop talking; to be quiet; shut up.
To provide with, or allocate to, a zip code.
To fasten (something) with a zip tie.
To be very large.

phrasal_verbs.gloss: To close with a zip fastener.

tatoeba.en: I realized that my zip was undone.
tatoeba.vi: Tôi nhận ra rằng khóa quần mình chưa được kéo lên.

tatoeba.en: Mary asked Tom to zip up her dress.
tatoeba.vi: Mary đã nhờ Tom kéo khóa váy lên giúp cô ấy.
